title: Latchkit staged update record v1
description: Result of downloading, verifying, extracting, and staging a bound update preview (issue #139) into its immutable versions/<key> directory via the manager's stageBundle. Deliberately excludes any activation state: staging this record never changes `current`, the managed launchers, or the runtime a new launch resolves to. Stored beside the activation pointer, installation-scoped, never per project.

previewId.description: Binds this staged record back to the exact preview (version, asset identity, checksum) it was built from.

key.description: The versions/<key> directory name (version-target), matching the manager's own immutable version-directory naming.

directory.description: Absolute path to the staged immutable version directory. Empty only for a failed record whose staging never reached a resolved version directory.

authorizedMode.description: The update mode in effect when staging completed.

authorizedRevision.description: The update settings revision in effect when staging completed. A future automatic-activation step must re-check this against the current settings revision (see isStagedUpdateEligibleForAutomaticActivation) before activating.
